transit_crossing.description: Transit lines on their own bridges or as a second deck.
transit_crossing.title: Transit Crossing

Cliff.description:
A district standing on a plateau: its edges rise `height_m` over `width_m` (a cliff
where narrow, an escarpment where wide); at the sea it is a sea cliff.

facing.description: Sides where the edge is a cliff; on the other sides the plateau rises over a broad slope (`slope_m`). Left out: a cliff all round.
facing.title: Facing

Cliff.title: Cliff

side.description: Side of the map where the open sea is.
side.title: Side

name.description: Name of the sea or bay, e.g. 'West Bay'.
name.title: Name

sea_share.description: Fraction of the map that is sea, offshore islands included (they are carved out of it). Default by form.
sea_share.title: Sea Share

headlands.description: Peninsula only: the land widens from a neck toward the sea and fans out into this many headlands with coves between them, instead of ending in one rounded tip.
headlands.title: Headlands

Decks.description:
M14: an upper deck city over part of the district: a slab on columns over a cluster of
its blocks and the local streets between them, with streets, lots and buildings of its own,
ramps down to the ground streets, light wells with stairs and elevators.

height_m.description: Deck top over the ground under it (the lower level keeps 5.5 m of clear height for traffic under the slab).
height_m.title: Height M

cover.description: Target share of the district's land under the deck.
cover.title: Cover

column_m.description: Column grid: no point of the slab farther than about this from a column.
column_m.title: Column M

light_m.description: No walkway under the deck farther than this from open sky (light wells and the deck edge).
light_m.title: Light M

ramps.description: Two-way street ramps between the deck and the ground streets.
ramps.title: Ramps

upper.description: Program of the buildings on the deck (default: the district's); under the deck the lots get low buildings that fit the clear height.
upper.title: Upper

upper_height_m.description: Height range of the buildings on the deck, over its top (default: the district's).
upper_height_m.title: Upper Height M

Decks.title: Decks

area_share.description: Fraction of the land area. Missing shares split the remainder by archetype weight.
area_share.title: Area Share

seed.description: Per-district seed; default derived from the city seed and the name.
seed.title: Seed

variety.description: M21: how far the district's towers depart from boxes (0: boxes and mild forms, rounded or cut corners, setbacks; 1: twisted, leaning, stacked, split, cantilevered, framed and podded towers, the twist and lean at their most); default by archetype.
variety.title: Variety

wealth.description: M11: base of the wealth field.
wealth.title: Wealth

danger.description: M11: base of the danger field.
danger.title: Danger

police.description: M11: base of the police presence field.
police.title: Police

faction.description: M11: the faction that holds the district (districts with the same faction share it); default: a generated gang where the district is dangerous, a corporation in corporate districts, else the police.
faction.title: Faction

decks.description: M14: a layered district: an upper deck city over the ground streets.

junctions.description: M18: signals and crosswalks by need (default 'auto' for both).

Grades.description:
M18: grades of the raised roads (steeper and shorter than M7's 5%, leaving less dead
space under them).

run.description: Design grade of a viaduct run's ends down to the ground.
run.title: Run

run_max.description: Steepest a viaduct run may be.
run_max.title: Run Max

ramp.description: Design grade of ramps, loops, flyovers and stack ramps.
ramp.title: Ramp

ramp_max.description: Steepest a ramp, loop, flyover or stack ramp may be (and any raised road).
ramp_max.title: Ramp Max

curve_m.description: Vertical curves of the runs and ramps.
curve_m.title: Curve M

Grades.title: Grades

elevated_share.description: Share of highway length on viaducts.
elevated_share.title: Elevated Share

crossings.description: Interchange where two highways cross with room for it: a four-level stack or a turbine (each the other's fallback).
crossings.title: Crossings

at.description: Where its top stands: a district (its middle), a direction or 'center'.
at.title: At

radius_m.description: Where the slope ends; the steepest slope is about 1.5 times height / radius.
radius_m.title: Radius M

position.description: Where on the map, relative to the center. Shorthand 'south_west_offshore' sets position and setting together.
position.title: Position

river.description: River for mid_river and delta islands.
river.title: River

pinned.description: The island is a traced district (its coast, roads and buildings kept as drawn); area_km2 then comes from the tracing.

JunctionControl.description: M18: crossings by need in a district.

signals.description: 'auto': signals where two primary roads meet, and where a street meets one (or at a street crossing in the corporate core, transit hub and midtown) with no signalized junction within 120 m along either road (200 m in the old town and entertainment market); 'fewer': twice that spacing and no street crossing signalized; 'none': no signals.
signals.title: Signals

crosswalks.description: 'auto': crosswalks on the approaches of signalized junctions and across avenues where none is within the signal spacing; 'fewer': at signalized junctions only; 'none': unmarked crossings everywhere.
crosswalks.title: Crosswalks

JunctionControl.title: JunctionControl

kind.description: snake_case generator kind, e.g. megatower, spire, arcology, ferris_wheel.
kind.title: Kind

height_limit_m.description: Building height cap around the site (spaceport flight cone).
height_limit_m.title: Height Limit M

connects.description: Two districts, islands, places or exits ('west_exit') it joins.
connects.title: Connects

tunnel.description: True: an immersed tube instead of a bridge where one fits (M9); false: always a bridge; left out: as highways.tunnels.water decides.
tunnel.title: Tunnel

reuse.description: False: the route keeps to its own line and crosses the highways it meets instead of running along them (a crosstown; M12 builds a stack where it crosses one with room).
reuse.title: Reuse

Pinned.description: A traced district imported as fixed (scope 4.3).

source.description: Repo path of the traced SVG, in the conventions of maps/corporate_core_v*.svg (coast, highway, building, landmark layers).
source.title: Source

rotation_deg.description: Counterclockwise turn of the traced map.
rotation_deg.title: Rotation Deg

Pinned.title: Pinned

kind.description: Place kind. A megasite kind (e.g. temple_complex) turns the place into a named megasite when defaults are filled.
kind.title: Kind

coast.description: True: on the sea coast. False: inland.
coast.title: Coast

separated_by.description: Boundary kind (water, river, channel, canal, sea, highway, ring_road, rail, wall) or the name of a river.
separated_by.title: Separated By

from.description: One end: a district, a direction or 'center'.
from.title: From

kind.description: 'channel' is a wide sea channel or strait (sea-class clearance).
kind.title: Kind

at.description: Position along the edge, 0 to 1: west to east on the north and south edges, south to north on the east and west edges; on a diagonal edge 0 is the middle of the first-named side, 0.5 the corner, 1 the middle of the second side. Default 0.5.

from.description: Map edge where the river enters, or {edge, at} to pin where along that edge.
from.title: From

at.description: Position along the edge, 0 to 1: west to east on the north and south edges, south to north on the east and west edges; on a diagonal edge 0 is the middle of the first-named side, 0.5 the corner, 1 the middle of the second side. Default 0.5.

to.description: Mouth: 'sea', 'bay', a map edge direction, or the name of another river (tributary). {edge, at} pins the mouth along a map edge (for 'sea' and 'bay': along the sea-side edge; for a tributary: along the parent, 0 = where the parent enters, 1 = its mouth).
to.title: To

width_m.description: [min, max] width. Default 60 to 120 for rivers, 150 to 300 for channels.
width_m.title: Width M

delta_branches.description: Extra distributary channels near the mouth, besides the main channel (four channels in total = 3).
delta_branches.title: Delta Branches

image.description: Repo path of the concept image, if any.
image.title: Image

Terrain.description: The ground (M13). Left out, the city is flat at sea level, as before M13.

shore_m.description: Ground over the water at a low shore.
shore_m.title: Shore M

inland_grade.description: How the land rises away from the sea (a fraction, 0.01 = 1%).
inland_grade.title: Inland Grade

relief_m.description: Rolling ground: amplitude of a smooth random relief.
relief_m.title: Relief M

Terrain.title: Terrain

hubs.description: Interchange names (districts, places or megasites). Default: transit hub districts and transit_nexus sites.
hubs.title: Hubs

route.description: Stops in order: districts, hubs, places, megasites, islands or '<direction>_exit'. Repeat the first stop at the end for a loop.
route.title: Route

altitude_m.description: [min, max] track altitude; default by mode, checked against mode limits.
altitude_m.title: Altitude M

through_towers.description: sky_tube only: passes through tower portals.
through_towers.title: Through Towers

water.description: Immersed tubes under rivers, channels and the bay for highway crossings (M9): 'auto' where a bridge does not fit (a sea crossing over 600 m of water); 'prefer' every river and sea crossing where a tube fits; 'never' bridges only. A named crossing stays a bridge unless its 'tunnel' asks for a tube. A tube needs a straight approach on both banks with no junction but avenues that cross over it or end beside it.
water.title: Water

under.description: Districts a highway passes under in a cut-and-cover tunnel, with a green lid over it, where the tunnel fits between its interchanges.
under.title: Under

underpasses.description: Pedestrian underpasses under at-grade highways, between the frontage streets on both sides (share of the spots that fit).
underpasses.title: Underpasses

boundary_water_share.description: water_preferred: target share of the boundary between neighboring districts that runs along water (rivers, channels, separation canals). The build adds separation channels, preferring boundaries that already run near water, until the share is reached.
boundary_water_share.title: Boundary Water Share

terrain.description: M13: hills, ridges, cliffs, flat districts. Left out: flat ground.
